provenance.construction: Start with two [[4,2,2]] plaquette codes on adjacent 2x2 squares. Deform by adding one X-type stabilizer equal to the product of the same weight-2 logical X representative on each block (supports [0,1,4,5]); retain both block stabilizer pairs. The added local check couples the blocks, so this is not a direct sum.
provenance.notes: Checked against the board: no exact or Weisfeiler-Lehman equivalent entry. See notes/8-3-2.md.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=2 per check, 4 X + 4 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)

contributed_by.method: circuit_autogen schedule search (two-block interleaved, then layout, then generic), verified by verify/circuit_verify.py before writing
